topicFamilies.label: Pediatric / infant technical preparation
topicFamilies.authorityBoundary: AASM technical/scoring authority comes first. AAST Standard PSG is adult workflow guidance and must not be presented as pediatric PSG authority; local age-specific execution remains facility specific.

topicFamilies.label: Current pediatric scoring
topicFamilies.authorityBoundary: Current AASM Version 3 controls rule-sensitive pediatric scoring; books and cases are supporting examples only.

topicFamilies.label: Current infant scoring and developmental context
topicFamilies.authorityBoundary: AASM infant/pediatric scoring rules govern; the infant atlas is developmental and visual support, not current scoring authority.

topicFamilies.label: Pediatric CO2, hypoventilation, and oximetry
topicFamilies.authorityBoundary: Current AASM rules govern scoring. ETCO2 and TcCO2 remain distinct technologies, and oximetry must not be treated as a substitute for ventilation assessment.

topicFamilies.label: Current pediatric PSG-MSLT preparation
topicFamilies.authorityBoundary: The 2024 AASM pediatric MSLT protocol governs pediatric daytime-test preparation/procedure where applicable; older pediatric MSLT parameters must not override it.

topicFamilies.label: Pediatric / infant documentation and reporting
topicFamilies.authorityBoundary: AASM controls required scoring/reporting elements; facility policy controls local technical notes, accommodations, caregiver context, and escalation documentation.
